channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: The latest: Jessie Diggins finishes eighth in first race of her final Olympics
item.description: Lindsey Vonn completed another downhill training run on her injured left knee while Jessie Diggins and the U.S. women’s hockey team were also in action on Saturday in Italy.

item.title: Why Drake Maye gave Twins pitcher Bailey Ober a shoutout before Super Bowl
item.description: Super connection: Twins pitcher Bailey Ober used to babysit Drake Maye at their brothers’ sporting events in North Carolina.

item.title: Timberwolves respond to Rudy Gobert’s comments: ‘That’s been addressed’
item.description: The center had called on coach Chris Finch to start benching players who give lackluster effort on defense.

item.title: Review: Eric Church mixes Pink Floyd, big-band arrangements for maverick country music
item.description: His marathon St. Paul concert was musically rewarding.

item.title: Strictly x Strib Varsity Tour: Maddyn Greenway of Providence Academy scores 57 vs. Hill-Murray
item.description: Maddyn Greenway, Minnesota’s top player, scored 57 points, including 39 in the second half, in a game that featured several top-ranked girls basketball players.

item.title: A state on edge: What the last 31 days have looked like in Minnesota
item.description: Here’s what it looked like since Renee Good was fatally shot by an ICE agent.

item.title: Ramstad: The Great Wrecking of Minnesota is underway
item.description: Republicans overreacted to illegal immigration and fraud. Democrats did the same with the state’s social service providers. Collateral damage is in every corner of the state.

item.title: The latest: Homeland Security defends conditions for detainees at Whipple
item.description: DHS pushed back on Rep. Kelly Morrison’s characterization of poor conditions for detainees at the Fort Snelling federal building.

item.title: Veteran ICE officer went from fearing for his life to taking a life
item.description: A June immigration bust that went awry left Jonathan Ross bleeding in the street. Back on the job seven months later, his killing of Renee Good ignited a debate over federal immigration policy.

item.title: Minneapolis tells residents to stop building anti-ICE barricades, but they keep popping up
item.description: Minneapolis officials are urging residents not to block traffic as neighbors build makeshift checkpoints to slow and track federal immigration agents.
